source.download_note: GitHub blob API content is base64; decode to exact source bytes, not the API JSON body
source.patch: Exactly one CLIPModel.from_pretrained call gains local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True. Applied in memory only after both source hashes match reviewed constants.

preprocessing: RGB; torchvision Resize((336,336)) default bilinear; ToTensor; CLIP mean [.48145466,.4578275,.40821073], std [.26862954,.26130258,.27577711]

protocol.model: Author CLIP v2: six experts, rank one, top two, router hidden 256, hybrid true; all parameters frozen
protocol.roles: Partition_rows seed42; verification reads exactly two selection-role images (one real, one AI), never calibration/evaluation/holdout for model checks. Evaluation reads only calibration/evaluation image files; train and sealed holdout remain untouched.
protocol.resource_guard: New wrapper takes the shared gpu0-research.lock and requires physical GPU 0 memory.used <=1024 MiB before verification and evaluation; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0. Root-controlled queue waits for FFHQ audit.
protocol.run_status: Evaluation creates an exclusive output directory, writes running status and resolved_config.json, then completed/exit0 or failed/exit1. Existing run directories and their status are never overwritten.
protocol.scores: Author output is softmax[:,1]=p_ai, converted to [1-p_ai,p_ai] without a second sigmoid
protocol.activation: New wrapper verifies two real selection-role images, cached batch versus recomputation, batch versus single, and full model reload; binds receipt and enables this new config only on success. automatic_execution stays false. Legacy config and runner remain untouched.
protocol.overlap_caveat: Author pretrained detector training coverage may overlap IAB generators or images; absence of overlap is not established. This is frozen pretrained detection evaluation, not a 30-epoch trained-head result or clean out-of-distribution claim.
